verdict.rationale: Cerebras' whole value proposition centers on speed: dedicated wafer-scale inference, TTFT-optimized SDK warming (cerebras-gh-1), streaming API (cerebras-docs-5), dedicated non-shared capacity for consistent latency (cerebras-docs-24), and cache-hit optimizations for throughput (cerebras-docs-12/19/22). Independent hands-on community reports strongly corroborate extreme throughput/low-latency (300+ tok/s coding model, beating 8x H100 clusters, 'needlessly fast' code gen) across multiple HN threads (cerebras-comm-1,6,7,10,13,14,15). Missing for 10: no first-party published TTFT/tok-s benchmark numbers in this pack, and some community reports note rate-limit throttling and onboarding friction that slightly tempers the sustained-throughput story (cerebras-comm-11,4).
